chunks: With this chain of narrators, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Fadala, from al-Aban, from Abu al-Jarud, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them both)

regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And by the witness, and by what is to be witnessed». He said: The witness is Friday, that which is to be witnessed is the Day of Arafah, and that which is promised is the Day of Resurrection.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'the witness and the witnessed' in Surah Al-Mutaffifin according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this interpretation from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), linking the 'witness' (shahid) to Friday, the 'witnessed' (mashhud) to the Day of Arafah, and the 'promised' (ma'ud) to the Day of Resurrection. This exegesis highlights the spiritual hierarchy of time in Shia tradition, where Friday serves as the weekly witness to Arafah, the pivotal day of Hajj and divine mercy, which in turn points toward the ultimate accountability of the Hereafter.
